result.instructions: Tools for Webshipper, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still pending dispatch today?"; "Show me the shipments and tracking events for order 12345."; "Which carriers are connected to my Webshipper account?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Webshipper data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run webshipper_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run webshipper_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run webshipper_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. webshipper_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: webshipper_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders in the Webshipper account, 30 per page. Filter by status, your own reference, channel, destination country, free text or creation date. Use page to read more. Webshipper API: GET /orders.

status.description: Status, or several comma-separated: pending, dispatched, partly_dispatched, cancelled, error, missing_rate, on_hold.

delivery_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DK.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_to.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: webshipper_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its status, delivery and sender addresses, and order lines. Webshipper API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: webshipper_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments (parcels booked with a carrier), 30 per page. Filter by order, carrier, status, tracking number, reference, destination country, return flag, free text or creation date. Webshipper API: GET /shipments.

order_id.description: Order id the shipments belong to.

carrier.description: Carrier id or name, as Webshipper filters it.

delivery_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DK.

is_return.description: true for return shipments only, false for outbound only.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_to.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: webshipper_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment by id: carrier, service, tracking number, status and addresses. Webshipper API: GET /shipments/{id}.

tools.name: webshipper_list_tracking_events
tools.title: List tracking events
tools.description: List carrier tracking events (scans and status changes), 30 per page. Pass shipment_id to read one shipment's history. Webshipper API: GET /tracking_events.

shipment_id.description: Shipment id; leave out to list events across shipments.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_to.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: webshipper_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: List the carriers connected to the Webshipper account (ids, names, carrier types). Use the id in shipment filters. Webshipper API: GET /carriers.

tools.name: webshipper_list_order_channels
tools.title: List order channels
tools.description: List the order channels (shops or marketplaces that send orders to Webshipper), 30 per page. Use the id in order filters. Webshipper API: GET /order_channels.

tools.name: webshipper_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create a new order in Webshipper with a delivery address and order lines. Use a new ext_ref for every order: Webshipper's response may not return the new order id, so find the order later with webshipper_list_orders and ext_ref. Creating an order can start shipping work in the account. Webshipper API: POST /orders.

ext_ref.description: Your unique order reference. Use a new value for each order.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR or DKK.

state.description: State or region, where the country uses one.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DK.

sender_address.description: Sender address; leave out to use the account default.

state.description: State or region, where the country uses one.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DK.

create_shipment_automatically.description: Passed to Webshipper as create_shipment_automatically. Leave out to keep the Webshipper default.

tools.title: Get rate quotes
tools.description: Ask Webshipper which shipping rates apply to one parcel sent to an address. Returns the quotes it finds. Webshipper API: POST /rate_quotes.
